item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khros ma'i rgyud las lcags sdig nag po dam sri tsita gtub byed
item.coloph: ces pa lcags sdig nag po dam sri tsita gtub byed zhes bya ba sngags 'chang mkha' spyod pa gar dbang byang chub rdo rje (rjer) mkha' 'gros brgyud bzhin phyi rabs don du sbyar ba'o//
